title: 6.10 Can You Help Me Get There?
unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
sub_lesson_title: Can You Help Me Get There?
goal: Complete a directions conversation and use the reply to reach the intended destination.
grammar_function: Ana is going to the mall but needs directions. She approaches one person, asks for help and hears Sorry, no. A clear transition introduces Luis as a different helper. He agrees, hears the named destination, gives a usable route, receives thanks, and Ana follows the route to the mall. This is where the fuller story and conversation belong.
prerequisite: Units 1–5 and the earlier Unit 6 lessons in the displayed course sequence.
speaking_outcome: Complete a directions conversation and use the reply to reach the intended destination.
